title: kate-search: skip a find for an empty regex
summary: find_next returns Ok(None) when the regex pattern is empty. find_all still runs. An invalid regex still returns the error. The test goes in the existing find_tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition:
pub fn find_next(
    buf: &TextBuffer,
    q: &SearchQuery,
    from: Offset,
    backwards: bool,
    wrap: bool,
) -> Result<Option<Match>, SearchError>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: lib.rs has one test module named find_tests. Add the new function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not add mod tests. Do not add a second find_tests module. In find_next, after the empty escape check, return Ok(None) when the pattern is Pattern::Regex and the string is empty. An invalid regex still returns Err. A non-empty regex still searches. The empty Plain check and the empty escape check stay as they are. find_all stays as it is. Leave bar.rs and regex_find.rs unchanged. The test an_empty_regex_pattern_returns_none uses the buffer abc. An empty Regex pattern makes find_next from offset 0, backwards false, and wrap false return None. find_all on that query returns Ok. The regex a from offset 0 returns the hit 0..1. The regex ( returns Err. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: find_tests::an_empty_regex_pattern_returns_none
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. find_next returns a hit for an empty regex. After the change it returns None. find_all still returns Ok. The regex a returns the hit 0..1. The regex ( returns Err.
